text: When the loop guard stops a build's agent at max effort, the build runs it once more at xhigh, in the same workspace, and says so. Only builds fall back: drafts, plans and reviews stay at max, and every first run is at max. #91's build looped at max again on 2026-09-29, after agents were told to write as they go, and Claude Code ignores thinking budgets on adaptive-reasoning models, so effort is the only control. @gitdek chose this over splitting #91 or capping thinking, which those models don't allow. #154 builds it.
